label: Typewriter
description: Character-by-character type-on with a riding cursor, in three voices: 'glass' (default, the dark glass card), 'print' (ink typewriter slab sitting directly on the world's surface -- the paper-film voice), and 'cli' (a monospace command line with a chevron prompt and block caret -- for typed commands like 'ask quotient to...'). Scrub-safe pre-laid characters.

hold_cursor.label: Blink the cursor after typing completes (default true)

pretyped.label: Prefix already standing at frame one (a string -- its length is used -- or a character count); typing continues from there. For continuing a sentence across a boundary or era flip instead of retyping it.
